name: Scan
doc: Scan (spell): one emitter per action - its sound, the reticle closing on the target with its brackets and ring, the screen dimmed, the scan bars, the camera to the target, the viewer (the target's name and scan text, turned and zoomed with the pad) until confirmed, the camera back; the result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag040_scan.cpp) run on the program's memory (its camera state too, through its exe pointer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Scanner
